Ranger programs

All of these are free. Meet the ranger at the spot listed, about ten minutes before the start.

ProgramWhenWhereWith
Canoe tourSat, 7 amLodge dockInesCanoes and life jackets provided. Expect a race back to the dock.
Echo Point talk10 am and 2 pmThe rail at Echo PointJuneJune brings a stopwatch so you can time your own echo. Allow an hour for the walk up and back.
Star talkFri and Sat, 9 pmOutside the Pass HutRangersJune through September. It's a lot colder up there than down at the lake.
Old-growth walkSun, 4:30 pmCathedral Stand trailheadSamSam talks cedar for about an hour. The boardwalk is flat and wheelchair accessible.

Programs can be cancelled for weather. The lodge front desk posts any changes by 6 am.

Dark sky programs

The nearest town is sixty miles away, so the sky here gets properly dark. On a clear night at the pass you can see the Milky Way without even trying. Rangers set up telescopes outside the Pass Hut on Friday and Saturday nights from June through September. It's free and you don't need to book.

  • Star talks: Fri and Sat, 9 pm, outside Pass Hut
  • Dress warm and bring a red flashlight
  • Moonrise tonight: 9:14 pm
